name: Stephen M. Burstein
tagline: Top rated Criminal Defense attorney in Denver, Colorado
education: University of Denver Sturm College of Law
about: Stephen M. Burstein is an attorney with Springer & Steinberg, P.C., law firm, which has law offices in Denver and Grand Junction, Colorado. A nationally ranked trial lawyer with more than 10 years of total legal experience, Mr. Burstein focuses his practice primarily on criminal defense, and he provides unmatched counsel and support to clients across the state who stand accused of DUI or any other felony or misdemeanor offense.

A former Deputy District Attorney in the 18th Judicial District that serves Douglas and Arapahoe counties, Mr. Burstein has invaluable insight into the criminal justice system from both sides, which helps him devise the most effective defense strategies possible for his clients. As an attorney, he has gained a reputation for his aggressive advocacy both inside and outside of the courtroom, and he has achieved a long record of securing successful outcomes for his clients efficiently and cost-effectively.

Honored for his remarkable professionalism and outstanding client service, Mr. Burstein has earned a Top 40 Under 40 Trial Lawyer ranking from The National Trial Lawyers as well as designation as one of America’s Top 100 Criminal Defense Attorneys. He also holds a Lead Counsel designation, and he has received many other accolades and endorsements from his peers, including designation as among the Ones to Watch from Best Lawyers. He has also received numerous testimonials and referrals from his satisfied clients.

A 2007 graduate of The Ohio State University, Mr. Burstein attended the University of Denver's Sturm College of Law, where he obtained his Juris Doctor in 2011. He is admitted to practice before all Colorado state courts as well as before the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia. He is an active member of the Douglas County Bar Association and the Colorado Bar Association as well as the Colorado Criminal Defense Bar Association.
